tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bka' brgyud rin po che gser gyi phreng ba la bstod pa gsol 'debs dang bcas pa bzhugs so//

༄༅/ /khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po la bstod pa gzhom med rdo rje'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gyur bral mchog gi bde ba ma nyams rdo rje'i rang bzhin he ru kaḥ /rnam kun mchog ldan shes rab btsun mos rnam pa kun tu legs 'khyud cing*// zung 'jug bde chen ro la rtag rol dgyes pa mchog gi gar gyis rtsen// khyab bdag chos nyid sku can de la rnam pa kun tu bdag 'dud do// gdod ma'i mgon po mig stong ldan pa'i gar// gdul bya sna tshogs bai ḍūr 'dzin ma la// grangs med zhing dang sprul sku'i gar ci yang*// ston mdzad dpa' bo khyod la gus phyag 'tshal// lus ni dwangs shing rdul phran dag /mnyam pa nam mkha' dang mtshungs la// mtshan dpe'i dra ba rab rdzogs pa// rmi lam bzhin du snang der 'dud// skad ni kun nas chad pa med| |du ma'i skad gzhan dag gis kyang*// gzhan gyi snying la 'jug pa ste// sgra bral sgra dbyangs ldan der 'dud// sems ni dam pa'i bdes gang zhing*// mi g.yo thams cad dus kun tu// lhan cig skyes pas rab 'khyud pa// bco brgyad ma 'dres mnga' der 'dud// phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid las 'das shing*// pra phab pa ltar stong pa nyid kyi gzugs// shes bya kun gyi rnam par rab snang ba// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku can de la 'dud// rnam kun mchog ldan dmigs bcas stong nyid dang*// dmigs med snying rje mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i// bde chen dbyer med zung 'jug la rol ba// kha sbyor rdo rje'i sku mnga' de la 'dud// gang yang rtog pa med pa nyid// tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba// gzung 'dzin rnam rtog gtan spangs pa// bde chen rtog med de la 'dud// gshis kyi gnas lugs spros bral ba// rdzas sam dngos po der 'dzin gyis// bden par grub pa med pa'i phyir// rang bzhin skye med de la 'dud// dga' dang mchog dga' dga' bral lhan cig skyes// de dang der 'dzin gcig dang du ma sogs// mi mnga' zag med 'pho bral rtag brtan pa'i// 'gyur med snying rje nges gang de la 'dud// sngar nyid ji bzhin phyis de bzhin| |dngos med rtag pa ma yin par// kun gyi rtag pa'i sku can nyid// rgyun mi 'chad pa de la 'dud// cang med ci yang med la sogs pa yi// stong pa chad pa'i mtha' las ring 'das shing*// rnam pa kun tu chad pa mi mnga' ba'i// 'gag pa med pa'i lus can de la 'dud// rgyal ba bskyed yum srid pa'i nyes pas ma gos sgom par 'gyur bral zhing*// mkha' mnyam mun pa kun nas bcom zhing brtan g.yo thams cad la khyab pa// rnam par rtog bya chos kun spangs pa ye shes gzi brjid 'od gsal ba// srid pa'i dri ma 'phrog byed dpa' bo 'ba' zhig pa nyid de la 'dud// ji ltar mkha' bzhin mtha' dbus bral// rgya mtsho ji bzhin gting mi dpog

/spros bral mtshan ma kun spangs pa// chos kyi sku can de la 'dud| |snang ba kun las 'das kyang du mar snang*// stong pa'i chad char 'das kyang stong pa nyid// thabs shes zung 'jug mi 'gyur rtag 'char ba// longs sku nges pa lnga ldan de la 'dud// ji ltar rtog pa kun spangs pa// mkha' la shar ba'i ri bong can// chu snod kun tu shar ba ltar// sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku der 'dud// ma bcos rnyog ma dang bral rang bzhin khams// gzod nas bsal bzhag med pa kun tu bzang*// khyab dang du ma'i sku can gar dbang po// ngo bo nyid sku de la bdag 'dud do// rnam rtog tshogs kyi yul las khyod// 'das kyang rnam mi rtog ces pa// ngar 'dzin ri bo gzhom mkhas pa// ye shes sku mnga' de la 'dud// yan lag bdun ldan rgyal ba rdo rje 'dzin// de la bdag yid gus pas gsol 'debs kyi| |bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro tshogs ma lus pa// rdo rje 'chang dbang thob pa'i dge legs stsol// de ltar yul dang yul can las 'das pa// spros bral 'khor gsum yongs dag rab mtshan gyi// mtshan nyid 'dzin la bstod dang smad la sogs// kun brtags mtshan ma'i sgro skur su yis bgyid// 'on kyang rnam dkar dag pa'i blos// chos sku'i mdzad pa dang bcas par| |snyan tshig bstod pa'i dge tshogs kun// ma rnams de nyid 'thob phyir bsngo// zhes khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang la bstod pa gsol 'debs dang bcas pa gzhom med rdo rje'i glu dbyangs zhes pa 'di'ang*/ dge slong ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas/ me khyi snron gi zla ba'i dkar phyogs la rtse ba gzhis kar sbyar ba'o// //maṅgalaṃ// ༈ /rgyal sras til+li pa la bstod pa grub pa mchog gi zlos gar zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag srid zhi'i mtha' las khyod// rnam pa kun tu 'das mod kyang*// rnam kun mchog gi skur bstan der// rnam dag bstod pa'i zlos gar bgyid// 'phags pa'i yul du mkhas pa dang*// grub pa'i skyes bu ji snyed pas// sa steng til gyi gang bu ltar// gang bas khyod la 'dren pa su// khyod kyi 'bad pas ma bkug kyang*// srid zhi'i 'ching ba kun bcom pa'i// rab 'jigs khrag 'thung ma bzod par// rdo rje btsun mo dbang du phyug

/'jigs pa'i khengs pas sa gsum gyi// skye dgu 'jigs byed mkha' 'gro ma'i// gan mdzod khyod kyis dbang bsgyur nas// zab dgu blangs pa e ma 'jigs// chos nyid mtshan ma kun spangs kyang*// rab 'jigs mtshan ma he ru kaḥ /gar dgus dpa' ba khyod mthong bas// rgyal rnams skrag nas gshegs pa snyam// ji lta ji snyed dngos po kun// mtha' yas srid gsum lto bar yang*// mi shong ba de khyod gcig pu'i// sems kyis bcus pa de ci ga /srog dang bral yang srog ster zhing*// gang yang gang ltar sprul bsgyur ba// mi mtshungs ltar snang gshis de nyid// khyod nyid gcig pus rtogs de rmad// ba lang skyong ba'i zol gyis khyod// 'phye ste dpa' bo dbang lha mos// sdom pa'i pu tra sogs su bsngags// 'khor lo'i mgon po nyid du rtogs// rnam pa sna tshogs sgyu ma'i gar// rdzu dang 'phrul ba'i zlos gar gyis// sa steng grub chen ma lus pa'i// snyan grags rnga gsang khyod kyis phrogs// rgyal rnams 'gro la nye ring dag |spangs kyang rdo rje 'chang dbang po// dngos dang khyod nyid ma gtogs pa// ma 'phrad 'gro 'di ji ltar snyam// khyod ni sna tshogs gzugs can te// shes bya kun la thogs med 'jug /shes bya kun kyang khyod gcig pu// de phyir bstod pas ga la la// 'on kyang khyod kyi yon tan tshogs// cha tsam dran pas gnas de la// bdag cag yid dbang rab dang bas// gsol ba 'debs so de yi mthus// rnam pa kun tu 'khor ba'i mtsho// skye rga 'chi sogs ma ka ras// gang bar bying bdag khyod gcig pu'i// rdzu 'phrul phyag gis myur zungs shig /khyod kyi rtogs pa'i ye shes gang*// yi ge'i 'pho ba ji lta'i bar// bdag yid mos pa'i ka ka thar// dad pa'i ma shes sbag gi thob// 'khor 'das byed po sems yin na// khyod dang bdag sems tha dad pa| |gang gi sgo nas dbyer med pas// bdag kyang khyod bzhin grol bar mdzod// ngag lam yid kyi yul min pas// ci yang bstan du med do zhes// ji ltar khyod kyis nā ro par// bstan de bdag gi myur rtogs shog

/gang dag khyod la bstod pa dang*// gus pas gsol btab bden pa'i mthus// mtha' yas 'gro rnams khyod ji bzhin// rnal 'byor ma dang rtag rol shog /ces pa rgyal sras til+li pa la bstod pa gsol 'debs dang bcas pa grub pa mchog gi zlos gar zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ ra khyim nas dge slong ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas/ pho brang rtse ba gzhis kar sbyar ba sid+dhi rastu// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ /paṇa chen nā ro pa la bstod pa snyan grags lha yi rgyud mang zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mkhas dang grub pa'i gtsug rgyan me mur ba'i// snyan grags lha dbang gzhon nu'i dun+da bhiḥ /thos pas dad pa'i rgyan ldan mai na kaḥ /rab dwangs drug skyes rgyud mang 'di mchod sprin// kasmī ra yul gnyis skyes rigs gtsang mar// zhi ba'i go cha dpal gyi blo gros ma'i// srid pa bzung tshe dge mtshan ltas dang bcas// kun tu bzang por btags der mgos phyag 'tshal// der yang khyod kyis sgra tshad sogs// rnam dag rig lam bgrangs yas kyi// mkhas pa'i grags pas phyogs kyi ni// 'khor lo 'gengs mdzad de la 'dud// bud+dha pā las rab byung nas// sde snod gsum gyi pha mthar son// gtsug lag chen po'i sgo srung mdzad// snyan grags bzang por gtsug gis 'dud// rig lam stong phrag dal 'gro'i rgyun ldan sde snod dbu ma'i lang tsho ngoms// legs bshad zegs ma'i pha 'bab bzang pos 'dus tshogs 'bum phrag nyer 'dzin kyang*// rang sems ba yi nu 'then pa yi yun tsam zhig kyang gnas min pa// kye ma thos bsam sgom pa kho nas nges don rtogs min zhes khyod sems| |da ni sems la dbang 'byor ba'i// dam pa su zhes dpal khrag 'thung*// nyid la dris tshe shar phyogs su// til+li'i rigs zhes des lung bstan// de nas de nyid yid la rab sems pas| |phyogs rnams kun tu rgyu ba'i brtul zhugs kyis// btsal tshe de yi cho 'phrul ya ma zung*// mthong yang som nyi'i zol gyis dka' ba spyad// dam pa mchog de'i gsung gi bai ḍūr che// khyod kyi mos pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser bkod nas// dang du blangs bas dka' chen bcu gnyis sogs// gdul bya phyi ma'i don du bas par mdzad// kye ma srid gsum gnas kyi phun tshogs dpal 'byor ma lus lta zhog gi// 'khor 'das kun gyi 'byor ba'i phul la dbang bsgyur ma chags gang de yi// 'di yi sna dang rna ba'i tshom bu khrag gis sbags pa'i maṇ+ḍal la// dgyes pa ltar mdzad nges don nor bu de la bstsal zhes 'di ya mtshan// de nas de la thob pa'i nor// de nyid don dang ldan pa'i phyir// me tog mdangs ldan dang nye bar// bsgrubs pas de 'bras de na thob// rgyal rnams rgyal sras spyod pa nas bzung ji srid grangs med gsum la sogs// yun ring 'bad kyang legs par rnyed dka'i rnam dag byang chub go 'phang che// khyod kyis skad cig sgom dang 'bad pas ji lta de ltar de nyid don// skad cig 'bad med mngon du mdzad tshe rgyal ba rab 'byams dbugs 'byin mdzad// gang khyod la lar tshe 'dir mchog grub dang*// bar dor de 'grub pur sbyangs de nyid du// ngo mtshar mchod pa deng sang gi ni bar// yod ces gleng sogs ngo mtshar rnam thar gnas// 'dra dang 'dra min rnam mang po// byung ba'ang 'gal ba med mod kyi// grub pa brnyes pa'i cho 'phrul dang*// chos kun stong nyid yin phyir ro// de ltar mkhas dang grub pa'i rnam rol gyi// zol la brten pa'i yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas// dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kun gtso khyod zhabs la// bdag yid gus pas bcos min gsol 'debs kyi// bdag lus gdos bcas snang stong lha yi sku// tha mal ngag rlung rdo rje gsum gyi dngos// yid chos thig le ye shes rdo rje mchog

/thabs mchog bde chen haṃ yig zla bsil zer// shes rab tsaṇ+ḍa'i 'od kyis rab bskul tshe// bde chen rgyun chad med ba'i ga pu ra// 'dzag pas stong nyid kun+da rab rgyas shing*// chos kun 'od gsal dam pa 'ubs chub pa// zung 'jug sgyu ma'i lang tsho mdzes sdug gi// rnam kun mchog ldan dga' mar rtag rol cing*// sku gsum 'pho ba'i skyel bsu dang 'grogs pas// bar do ya nga'i 'phrang du mi 'phyo bar// snang phyogs bde chen khrag 'thung gang khyod dang*// stong nyid shes rab dga' mar rtag sbyor ba'i// gnas med gnas kyi mchog gyur nyams dga' bar// bdag sogs 'gro kun skad cig bgrod gyur cig /de ltar paṇa chen nā ro pa la bstod pa gsol 'debs dang bcas pa snyan grags lha'i rgyud mang zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ ra khyim nas mde'u sman dge slong ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis bskul ngor/ dbur stod 'bri gung du son pa dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pas/ rtse ba sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu sbyar ba dge bar gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /mnga' bdag mar pa lo tsā la bstod pa nags kyi gar mkhan zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa 'khor los sgyur// yon tan dbyar rnga thos pas gtsug phud can// dad pa'i 'dab ma gyen du bskyod pa yi// bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i rol pa ci yang 'dzin// he ru ka dpal dgyes mdzad rdo rje ni// skal bzang yid mkhar sna tshogs gar mdzad pa// zhing 'dir mar pa zhes bya sa gsum du// snyan pa'i ba dan 'dzin der gus pas 'dud// mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i kun rang bzhin// rnam kun stong nyid mchog gi ye shes dang*// gnyis su med pa kha sbyor rdo rje sems// khyab bdag he ru ka dpal de la 'dud// spros pa'i mtshan ma 'od gsal me chen gyis// bsregs nas dhū ti'i khyim du gnyid log pa// sngo bsangs dga' ma'i glu yis sad pa'i tshe// zung 'jug sgyu mar ldang ba de la 'dud// bcu drug lang tsho'i cha shas ma nyams pa'i// dpal ldan rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha' dbyings su// bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ro myang ba// lhan skyes rtag pa'i 'khor lo de la 'dud// thabs shes a haṃ dwangs ma'i rgyun bzang gis// 'byung ldog dga' ba bcu drug mthar son te// tshe gcig rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa bsgrubs pa// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mchog de la 'dud// rang bzhin rnam dag lhun grub 'dus ma byas// srid dang myang 'das mnyam pa nyid rtogs nas// dag pa gnyis ldan chos kyi sku grub pa// rgyal ba skyed mdzad de la gus pas 'dud// mchog dman gdul bya'i blo dang 'tsham pa yi// rnam 'phrul bkod pa sna tshogs cir yang ston// gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo ches// srid pa gcod mdzad de la gus phyag 'tshal// gsang sngags chos tshul zab mo'i khang bzang du// bde bar 'jug pa'i nges don sgo 'phar brgya// 'byed mkhas gangs can 'di na khyod las su// de phyir snying nas dad pas phyag bgyi'o// gzhan gyi dbang bzhi'i chu bo rdzogs pa bas// sbyangs rtogs sbar ba'i bdud rtsi sgrol ma lnga// rab 'bar ro 'dzin la reg don che ba// mthong thos don dang ldan la gus phyag 'tshal// thog med dus nas drin gyis bskyangs pa'i ma// 'jigs rung btson rar las kyi 'ching bas bcings// mi bzad sdug bsngal zug rngus non pa rnams// myur du skyob par nus par byin gyis rlobs// bslab gsum rin chen gdengs kas mdzes pa dang*// mang du thos pa'i nor gyis legs phyug ste// zhi lhag zung du 'brel ba'i ting 'dzin gyis// sgrib gnyis mun pa sangs bar byin gyis rlobs// dbang bzhi'i chu bo rdzogs par legs mnos te// snang phyogs rten dang brten pa'i ngo bor gsal| |stong phyogs skye 'gag bral ba'i nges shes kyis// rim pa dang po 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// yul dang yul can spros pa'i dra ba rnams// stong nyid 'od la me lces rab sbyangs nas| |chu la nya bzhin slob pa'i zung 'jug sku// tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis rlobs// gal te tshe 'dir mchog thob ma gyur na// gnas skabs gsum du sku gsum lam khyer nas// de dang de yi ngo bor grol ba yi// gdams pa'i gnad kyis zin par byin gyis rlobs// de yang las kyi bser bus khrid pa yis// srid pa gzhan du 'phyan par gyur pa na// gang du skyes kyang rgyu dang 'bras bu yi// theg pa gnyis la 'jug par byin gyis rlobs// dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes su 'dzin pa dang*// 'khor lo gnyis kyi bya bas dus 'da' zhing*// spangs dang rtogs pa'i yon tan mthar phyin nas// 'gro ba'i ded dpon chen por bdag gyur cig

/ces mnga' bdag mar pa lo tsā la bstod pa gsol 'debs dang bcas pa nags kyi gar mkhan zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po 'di nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa sdom brtson ka bcu pa ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ 'bri gung pa sngags 'chang chos kyi grags pas/ chu klung nā gardzu na'i sgra 'byin pa'i ngogs 'bri dam pa chos phyug gi pho brang dam par bris pa'o/// /sarba maṅga laṃ//

༈ /rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje la bstod pa yid kyi shing rta zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po seṅge rtsen la phyag 'tshal lo// rgya chen tshogs gnyis chu gter las 'ongs shing*// smon lam rta bdun shugs kyis drangs pa las// gangs can nam mkha'i lam du gar byed pa// grub mchog nyin byed dbang por gus phyag 'tshal// dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul ni// mi la zhes bya sa gsum 'jig rten du| |grags pa'i gdugs dkar rab tu g.yo ba yi// mtshungs bral dpa' bo de la gus phyag 'tshal// nā ro'i man ngag ga pur bsil ba'i rgyun// blo gros bai ḍū'i bum pa las byung ba// ngoms par 'thung bas srid pa'i tsha gdung rnams// skad cig bcil mdzad de la gus phyag 'tshal// gang gi snying stobs mtshon cha rnon po yis// lus srog gces 'dzin 'ching ba rab bcad nas| |brgya phrag dka' bas zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku// grub mdzad dbang phyug brgyad ldan de la 'dud// gzung 'dzin kun rtog nyi ma zla ba'i khams// ro rkyang srog rtsol dri len gyis drangs pa// gnyis spangs mun can khyim du rab bcom nas// ye shes rdo rje mnyes pa de la 'dud// gzhan gyis spang bar bya ba chags pa'i dug /ma spang pho nya ngang mo'i gdong pad du// bde chen stong pa'i ye shes ro myang ba// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug khyod la gus phyag 'tshal// tsaṇ+ḍa ye shes me yi reg pa yis// gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i dra ba kun za zhing*// thabs mchog ga pur chu yi bsil ldan pa| |bde chen he ru ka la gus phyag 'tshal// mkha' ltar dngos med e yig seṅge'i khrir// dngos po mchog ldan waṃ yig rdo rje'i sku// mi phyed gnyug ma'i ngang du ro mnyam pa// gdod nas rab zhi khyod la gus phyag 'tshal// dag dang ma dag gnyis snang sgyu ma yi// kun rtog 'od gsal me lces rab sbyangs nas// de las slar yang zung 'jug sgyu ma'i skur// skad cig ldang ba khyod la gus phyag 'tshal// gang gi mkhyen pa'i 'od snang cher 'bar bas// lta ngan 'byung po'i 'dab chags mig ldong zhing*// bskal bzang blo gros 'dab stong rab g.yo ba// nges don bstan pa'i nyi ma khyod phyag 'tshal// gus pa'i yid ni keṃ shu ka ltar g.yos// lus kyi spu ldang mchi ma'i char rgyun bab// gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis rtse gcig gsol 'debs na| |brtse bas gzigs shig thugs rje'i gter chen po// bskal mang rnyed dka'i gru chen 'di thob nas// don med tshe 'di'i bya ba 'ba' zhig gis// yun gyi don chen yal bar 'dor ba yi| |snying med po la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// 'dus byas mi rtag rlung nang mar me 'dra// rtag par 'dzin pa'i blo yi zhe gdeng gis// gnyid dang snyoms las le lo'i dbang gtong ba// snying med po la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// mi gtsang me dong lta bu'i 'khor ba la// bde bar 'dzin pa'i blo gros ngan pa 'dis// de las thar pa'i go skabs mi 'byed par// snying med po la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// las 'bras bslu ba med pa shes bzhin du// dge sdig blang dor tshul bzhin mi byed pa'i// sdug bsngal spong 'dod de rgyu sgrub pa yi// snying med po la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// mtha' yas sems can khams rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// mchog gsum skyabs kyi mchog tu legs bzung zhing*// tshul khrims mig 'bras bzhin du srung ba dang*| |byams dang snying rje byang chub sems gnyis 'byong*// smin lam dbang gi chu bos rgyud sbyangs nas// rim pa gnyis kyi lam mchog mthar phyin pas// yan lag bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang chen po'i// go 'phang tshe 'dir thob par byin gyis rlobs// zhes dbang phyug bzhad pa rdo rje la bstod pa gsol 'debs dang bcas pa yid kyi shing rta zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/

sdom brtson dam pa dge slong ka bcu pa ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis bskul ngor| 'bri gung pa rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pas/ 'bri chos phyug gi pho brang du mgyogs par bris pa shu bhaṃ// //sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /mnyam med sgam po la bstod pa dad pa'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba'i 'khor lo bar tha'i dgongs don rnams// gangs can khrod 'dir gyi nar ston pa kun// drang por gzud mdzad 'tsho mdzad de de yi// yon tan dran pas bstod dbyangs mgrin par 'dzin// gangs ri'i dbang po dang ldan pa'i// sa 'dir stong nyid smra bo lo// log smra'i wa tshogs ji snyed pa// rlung ltar 'phyo ba snyigs ma'i dus// dpal ldan zhi ba'i spo la rab gnas shing*// nges don gdams pa'i ral pa 'thug po 'dzin// stong nyid ji bzhin smra ba'i sbar khyim gyis// lta ngan wa tshogs klad pa 'gems der 'dud// khyod sngon me tog zla mdzes tshe// dpa' bas byin gyis rnam 'tshe yang*// byang chub sems la goms pa'i mthus// khro ba mi mnga' de la 'dud// bskal bzang 'di la 'dren mchog shākya yi// spyan sngar zla 'od gzhon nur zhes grags pa// mdo sde ting 'dzin rgyal po la sogs pas// yongs su tshims par mdzad der mgos phyag 'tshal// srid 'dir bltams nas gso rig la// legs sbyangs khyim ni dug sbrul gyis// bcings pa ltar gzigs nges par 'byung*// drang srong chen po de la 'dud// mar me mdzad dpal byang chub sems kyi rgyun// bya dang lcags ri gnyug rum la sogs la// gang bab khyed thugs gser gyi kum+bha ru// legs par gdams par de la gus phyag 'tshal// gang gis sgrub la gzhol ba'i tshe// gser 'od dam pa nas gsungs ltar// ji bzhin mtshan ma rab rdzogs pa// sa bcu mngon mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal// rigs dang dkyil 'khor ma lus dbang bsgyur khyab bdag bzhad pa rdo rje yi// mtshan thos tsam gyis mos par gyur gang keṃ shu'i 'dab ma rlung bskyod bzhin// de yi byin rlabs skad cig la zhugs 'khor 'das chos kun stong nyid rtogs// sems can kun rgyud shes pa'i nyams sogs yon tan mnga' bdag de la 'dud// de nub de na gsol btab pas// ya mtshan mtshan ma kun mthong nas// chas pas dam pa de zhabs 'dud// las can khyod la bdag 'dud do// grub chen rgyal po de zhabs myur phyin tshe// snod bcud rten 'brel ra sa yā na yi// dam tshig rdzas kyi rten cing 'brel 'byung chos| |ma lus rtogs par mdzad der bdag phyag 'tshal// dam pa de yis smin pa dang*// grol ba'i lam bzang kun bstan tshe// ji bzhin yon tan mthar phyin pa// mnyam med mchog der mgos 'dud do// ji ltar rgyal bas rgyal tshab ma pham pa// gnang ba ji ltar bstsal ltar des de ltar// dbugs dbyung bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol ba// 'dzam gling grags pa'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal// gang gis sgrub la gzhol tshe grub pa'i ltas// ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul sku yi bkod pa sogs// ya mtshan rmad byung bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal// rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab khyod la bdag phyag 'tshal// rnam dag lta ba zab mo sgom pa dang*// rgya chen spyod dang zab mo phyag rgya che// bka' phyag chu bo bzhi yis yongs gtams pa'i// gdengs can dbang po de la bdag 'dud do// zhing 'dir nges don gdams pa yis// 'gro kun dam pa'i sar 'khrid pa// mnyam med bsod nams rin chen la// rab gus mchog gis gsol 'debs kyi// rdzogs 'tshang rgya ba'i rgyu drung po// byams dang snying rje las skyes pa'i// rnam dag byang chub sems gnyis kyis// bdag rgyud yongs su rgyas gyur cig

/kun rdzob sems de las skyes pa'i// stong pa nyid dang snying rje mchog /zung 'jug bcos min don dam pa'i// byang chub sems kyis bdag brlan shog /de yang ma skyes skye med don// bsal bzhag spangs pa'i rang rig pa// yang dag yang dag gis bltas pas// yang dag mthong zhing rtogs par shog /rang gis ji ltar rtogs de ltar// mkha' mnyam ma gyur tshogs kyis kyang*// 'bad pa med par legs rtogs nas// gdod ma'i sa ru phyin par shog /ces mnyam med sgam po pa la bstod pa gsol 'debs dang bcas pa dad pa'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ dge slong ka bcu pa ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis bskul bar/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong rig pa smra ba chos kyi grags pas/ rtse ba gzhis kar sbyar ba swa sti pra dze bh+yaḥ sarba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ /mgon po phag mo gru pa la bstod pa rab dkar lhag bsam gyi ba dan zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po ngag gi bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo// mkhas dang grub pa'i bdag po sa gsum na// mtshan dkar dbyar gyi rnga sgra dang 'grogs pa'i// gtam 'di mos pa'i lhag bsam rab dkar ba'i// bstod tshig ba dan bzang po srid rtser 'phyo// bskal bzang rgyal ba'i thog ma 'khor ba 'jig /srid 'dir dge ba'i bshes kyi rdzu bag gis// ngur smrig gar gyis rol pa sa gsum gyi// skye dgu'i mgon po de la mgos phyag 'tshal// 'khor lo bar pa'i dgongs don pha rol phyin// zab mo stong nyid rab ston tshad ma'i mdo// theg chen dbu ma la sogs legs sbyangs pas// mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan de la bdag phyag 'tshal// bstan la bsnyen rdzogs 'dul mngon pha mthar phyin// mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i tshig don hub kyis bzhes// 'gran dang bral ba'i grags pa sa gsum 'bar// dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// thos pa rgya mtsho'i de nyid sgom pa'i tshe// lam rtags drod tshad 'ga' zhig mngon du mdzad// brtson byas 'khor lo gnyis kyis dus 'da' ba// mnyam med 'gro mgon de la bdag phyag 'tshal// ā nan+da la gdams pa'i bogs dbyung tshe// mthong lam yin zhes mu cor la bab pas// mnyam med 'tsho byed zhabs rdul spyir blangs nas// 'khrul med lam bzang brnyes der phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba mchog de'i byin rlabs don dam pa'i// 'pho bas 'khor 'das chos rnams skad cig rtogs// bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems gcig tu 'dres// mngon par byang chub khyod la bdag phyag 'tshal// zhing khams kun gtso kun bzang nags khrod du// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sgreng bar mdzad pa'i tshe// rgyal dang de sras paṇa grub du ma yis// mngon sum rjes bzung de la phyag 'tshal lo// gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg la dbang bsgyur bas// rtsa rlung thig le dwangs pas ḍā ki nī// sna tshogs dbang bsdus 'pho med bde stong 'bar// 'khor lo'i dbang phyug khyod la bdag 'dud do// thog med dus nas mngon par sangs rgyas kyang*// srid 'dir sna tshogs rnam 'phrul sgyu ma'i gar// cir yang bstan pas 'gro la dge ba'i lam// gsal mdzad 'gro mgon de la bdag phyag 'tshal| |shar phyogs rdul dang bral ba'i zhing khams su// rgyal ba mi bskyod rgyal po'i sras thu bo// blo gros dri ma med par 'gyur zhes gsungs// dus gsum rgyal ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo| |kun bzang nags kyis bkra ba'i zhing khams der// dus gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po rdo rje rgyal// ris med 'gro la dam pa'i lam ston pa// mnyam med bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs| |bdag sogs mtha' yas sems can ma lus pa// ngan song gsum las rnam par grol ba dang*// dal 'byor mchog thob rgyal ba'i bstan la 'jug

/dam pas rjes bzung rgyu yi theg pa yis// blo sbyangs smin byas sngags kyi sgor 'jug cing*// rim gnyis zab mo'i lam la rtag zhugs nas// khyab bdag zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang dbang po'i// go 'phang bde blag 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces mgon po phag mo gru pa la bstod pa gsol 'debs dang bcas pa rab dkar lhag bsam gyi ba dan zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ dge slong ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas/ pho brang rtse ba gzhis kar mgyogs par bris pa maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po la khyad par du 'phags pa'i rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi sgo nas bstod pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi sgra brgya pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten gsum na skye dgu mtha' dag gi// mgon po gcig sprul rgyal ba nyid sprul pa// 'bri gung par grags chen po kun gtso de'i// bstod dbyangs gser mngal ldan ba'i sgra 'di ko// dam pa mchog de'i rnam thar mi zad sgo// rgyal dang de sras phyogs bcur gang bzhugs pa// kun gyi lce brgya bskyod pas bsnyad na yang*// rdzogs par mi nus 'on kyang dad pa'i yid// rnam par g.yos pas cha shas re re yang*// brjod par rab 'byams tshogs kyi phul chen por// 'gyur zhes rnam 'dren mchog gis yang dang yang*// gang gsungs yid la brnags pa don ldan nyid// de phyir snyan ngag mkhan dbang rgan po ni// dbyangs can mgrin par chags pas legs bshad gtam// mos pa'i ba'ang spangs// mgul glor phan zhes glo ba'i sman// sman pas drangs kyang ma gnang bar// rnam gsum dag pa'i sha nyid kyang*// de 'dra na ni nyes pa'i tshogs// sum cu rtsa lnga ldan pa'i chang*// lta ci smos zhes rtsad nas spangs// mdor na chab tsha re tsam yang*// mthar thug nges pa'i tshogs su rol// gzhan la'ang ston 'di gnyis pa yin// thub pas bsngags pa'i chos gos gsum dang lhung bzed tsam las phan bde bsgrub pa'i phyir// chud gzon mi bya zhig po mi mdzad gzhan la'ang ston par rnam par thar pa gsum par grags| |rtag tu khyod thugs spros kun rab bral ba'i// mnyam par bzhag las mi g.yo mdzad pa kun// byang chub thugs kyis ma bzung cang ma mchis// sbyin pa tsam yang sems bskyed bsngo smon gyi// bar nas bton te byang chub chen por 'god// de nyid gzhan la'ang ston pa bzhi pa yin// khyod kyis rgyu 'bras rten 'brel kun// ris med mngon du gyur mod kyang*// bla ma'i gsung dang thub pa'i bkar// ma mchis pa dang lung med pa'i// chos dag gzhan la mi ston cing*// mkha' spyod yin yang rgyal ba'i gsungs// med na gshegs par mi bzhed la// spyir du mchog gsum rten dang ni// khyad par gsung rab dang khyod kyi// spyan dag nam yang mi 'bral zhing*// de ltar gzhan la'ang ston lnga pa// thugs rje chen pos sems can kun la gnod pa spangs pa dper na bla ma'i gdams pa yi// ched du'ang 'khrug pa rnam par spong zhing blo gros dgra bo nyid la dris nas yul de nyid// ji ltar 'dod pa de ltar mdzad nas byams pa chen po'i thabs kyis de dag khyad par du// gces par mdzad cing chos kyis rab 'dul de ltar gzhan la'ang ston pa 'di ni drug pa'o// rdzas dang yo byad gang ji snyed// gzhi rten gnas sar mi mdzad cing*// chos kyi mthun rkyen du bsgrub pa'i// zang zing ji tsam rgya che ba// de tsam dam pa'i chos btsal nas// phun tshogs 'dus pa'i sde 'ba' zhig

/skyong zhing sgrub pa byed la dgyes// gzhan la'ang de ston bdun pa'o// kun la snyoms pas rjes su 'dzin mkhas shing*// yon tan sna re tsam la'ang dgyes stsol la// snod ma yin pa'i sems can la gzigs khyod nyid ji bzhin rgyal bas kyang*/ */chos kun gshis babs de nyid bstan// rgyal bas nga nyid mi yul du// mi dang 'dra bar snang gsungs pa// mi bslu'i phyir na de nyid khyod// gcig pur nges kyi gnyis pa gang*// de ltar rgyal ba lha yi bla ma des// gdul bya rtag zhen can rnams ldog pa'i phyir// zung 'jug sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i cho 'phrul gar// 'od gsal thig le'i ngang du 'byams klas tshe// sku yi bkod pa du ma bstan// gdung dang ring bsrel char chen phab// mi bsrun pa rnams rab zhi zhing*// kun la ting 'dzin sgo brgya dang*// ya mtshan rtags kyi gdugs dkar pos// phyogs kyi 'khor lo gcig tu
